role.en: Director of AI & Distinguished Research Scientist, NVIDIA; Co-lead of GEAR Lab and Project GR00T
role.zh: NVIDIA AI 总监兼杰出研究科学家；GEAR Lab 与 Project GR00T 联合负责人

why.en: Author of Voyager and Eureka, which applied large models to open-ended learning in embodied agents. Leads the GR00T humanoid foundation model programme.
why.zh: Voyager 与 Eureka 的作者，将大模型用于具身智能体的开放式学习。领导 GR00T 人形机器人基础模型项目。

title.en: The robotics 'end game': the technology tree
title.zh: 机器人的「终局」：技术树

note.en: Predicts that by 2040 the industry reaches 'physical auto-research' — robots autonomously designing, improving and building their own next generation.
note.zh: 预测到 2040 年产业将进入「物理自动研究」阶段 —— 机器人自主设计、改进并制造下一代自身。

title.en: GR00T N1: an open foundation model for generalist humanoid robots
title.zh: GR00T N1：面向通用人形机器人的开放基础模型

title.en: Human2Any: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Constraint-Aware Compositional Planning
title.zh: Human2Any: Human-to-Robot Transfer via Constraint-Aware Compositional Planning

note.en: NVIDIA Research published Human2Any, a method for transferring human motion to robots via constraint-aware compositional planning, part of the GEAR lab's embodied-AI research line.
note.zh: NVIDIA Research 发布 Human2Any，一种通过约束感知式组合规划将人类动作迁移到机器人的方法，属于 GEAR 实验室具身智能研究方向的成果。

title.en: Good old days at OpenAI in 2016: an agent stares at screen pixels, moves a mouse, and books a flight on United. We called it World of Bits, inside OpenAI Univer
title.zh: Good old days at OpenAI in 2016: an agent stares at screen pixels, moves a mouse, and books a flight on United. We called it World of Bits, inside OpenAI Univer

note.en: Fan traced Astra's roots back to OpenAI's 2016 'World of Bits'/Universe project he worked on, framing today's agents as a decade-long continuation.
note.zh: Fan将Astra的渊源追溯到他参与过的OpenAI 2016年“World of Bits”/Universe项目，认为如今的智能体是十年积累的延续。

title.en: The sense of touch is the most criminally under-explored modality in robotics. Imagine doing sleight of hand wearing thick oven mitts. That's exactly how a robo
title.zh: The sense of touch is the most criminally under-explored modality in robotics. Imagine doing sleight of hand wearing thick oven mitts. That's exactly how a robo

note.en: Argues touch is the most under-explored modality in robotics, comparing today's robot manipulation to operating in oven mitts.
note.zh: 认为触觉是机器人学中最被忽视的感知模态，将当前机器人的操作能力比作戴着厚手套做事。

title.en: Seeing a hype wave around GEN-1.5, and rightfully so. Lots of respect to Pete & Andy for executing so well. The secret is in the naturally repetitive motions in
title.zh: Seeing a hype wave around GEN-1.5, and rightfully so. Lots of respect to Pete & Andy for executing so well. The secret is in the naturally repetitive motions in

note.en: Praises a robot demo's naturalistic motion and explains the key techniques enabling it.
note.zh: 称赞某机器人演示的自然动作表现，并解释了实现该效果的关键技术。

title.en: My morning ritual: coffee, then watch our robot assemble stuff. The model isn't fast, but it measures every grasp, obsesses over every alignment, and handles ev
title.zh: My morning ritual: coffee, then watch our robot assemble stuff. The model isn't fast, but it measures every grasp, obsesses over every alignment, and handles ev

note.en: Describes watching NVIDIA's robot learn precise assembly tasks, showcasing progress in dexterous manipulation.
note.zh: 描述观看英伟达机器人学习精细装配任务的过程，展示灵巧操作方面的进展。

title.en: We scaled a robot model natively to 8,000 timesteps of context, 5 minutes worth of muscle memory, with constant inference cost. Robot policies used to live thei
title.zh: We scaled a robot model natively to 8,000 timesteps of context, 5 minutes worth of muscle memory, with constant inference cost. Robot policies used to live thei

note.en: Announces a robot policy scaled natively to 8,000 timesteps of context — about five minutes of memory — at constant inference cost.
note.zh: 宣布将机器人策略原生扩展到8000个时间步（约五分钟记忆），且推理成本保持不变。

title.en: ENPIRE -> ASPIRE, our 2nd work in the series for Physical AutoResearch. We are building the components for robot self-improvement, one /skill at a time.
title.zh: ENPIRE -> ASPIRE, our 2nd work in the series for Physical AutoResearch. We are building the components for robot self-improvement, one /skill at a time.

note.en: Introduces ASPIRE, the second work in NVIDIA's Physical AutoResearch series building toward robot self-improvement.
note.zh: 介绍ASPIRE，英伟达“物理自动研究”系列的第二项工作，致力于实现机器人自我提升。

title.en: Today, we give robots a /skills library that self-evolves and compounds indefinitely! Introducing ASPIRE: a robot solving its 100th task is no longer as clueles
title.zh: Today, we give robots a /skills library that self-evolves and compounds indefinitely! Introducing ASPIRE: a robot solving its 100th task is no longer as clueles

note.en: Launches ASPIRE, a self-evolving robot skills library that compounds capability across tasks.
note.zh: 发布ASPIRE，一个可自我进化、随任务积累能力的机器人技能库。

title.en: I made Physical AutoResearch sound simple (conceptually), but it took a village to pull off and lots of design thinking into the robot /loopcraft. The hardest p
title.zh: I made Physical AutoResearch sound simple (conceptually), but it took a village to pull off and lots of design thinking into the robot /loopcraft. The hardest p

note.en: Reflects on the engineering effort behind Physical AutoResearch, describing the hardest parts of building the robot workflow.
note.zh: 回顾“物理自动研究”背后的工程投入，讲述打造机器人自动化流程中最难的部分。

title.en: Today, we enable AutoResearch in the physical world for the first time! Introducing ENPIRE: we give 8 Codex agents a fleet of robots, an allocation of GPUs, and
title.zh: Today, we enable AutoResearch in the physical world for the first time! Introducing ENPIRE: we give 8 Codex agents a fleet of robots, an allocation of GPUs, and

note.en: Announces ENPIRE, giving coding agents control of a robot fleet and GPU allocation to run physical-world autonomous research for the first time.
note.zh: 宣布ENPIRE项目，首次让编码智能体调度机器人集群和GPU资源，在物理世界中开展自动化研究。

title.en: NitroGen just won CVPR Best Paper Honorable Mention!! We are making strides towards general-purpose embodied agents that master not only the real world physics,
title.zh: NitroGen just won CVPR Best Paper Honorable Mention!! We are making strides towards general-purpose embodied agents that master not only the real world physics,

note.en: Announces NitroGen won a CVPR Best Paper Honorable Mention for advancing general-purpose embodied agents.
note.zh: 宣布NitroGen获得CVPR最佳论文荣誉提名，推动通用具身智能体的发展。

title.en: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI
title.zh: Cosmos 3: Omnimodal World Models for Physical AI

note.en: NVIDIA's Cosmos 3 family of omnimodal world models for physical AI, jointly handling language, image, video, audio and action; he is on the author list.
note.zh: 英伟达面向物理 AI 的 Cosmos 3 全模态世界模型系列，统一处理语言、图像、视频、音频与动作，他是作者之一。

title.en: Robotics' End Game with Nvidia's Jim Fan
title.zh: Robotics' End Game with Nvidia's Jim Fan

note.en: His Sequoia AI Ascent talk "Robotics' End Game", arguing robotics is repeating the LLM path from pre-training to reasoning and that world-action models displace conventional VLAs.
note.zh: 他在红杉 AI Ascent 上的演讲《机器人的终局》，提出机器人正在复刻大模型从预训练到推理的路径，世界—动作模型将取代传统的视觉-语言-动作模型。

title.en: I promise this will be the best 20 min you spend today! Robotics: Endgame, the sequel to my last year's Sequoia AI Ascent talk, "Physical Turing Test". I laid o
title.zh: I promise this will be the best 20 min you spend today! Robotics: Endgame, the sequel to my last year's Sequoia AI Ascent talk, "Physical Turing Test". I laid o

note.en: Promotes 'Robotics: Endgame,' his Sequoia AI Ascent talk laying out a roadmap for solving Physical AGI.
note.zh: 推介其在红杉AI Ascent大会的演讲《机器人：终局》，阐述解决“物理AGI”的路线图。

title.en: The power of the Claw, in the palm of a robot hand. Agentic robotics is here! Today, we open-source CaP-X: vibe agents, alive in the physical world. They incarn
title.zh: The power of the Claw, in the palm of a robot hand. Agentic robotics is here! Today, we open-source CaP-X: vibe agents, alive in the physical world. They incarn

note.en: Open-sources CaP-X, agentic robots that embody 'vibe agents' as robot arms and humanoids.
note.zh: 开源CaP-X项目，让“vibe智能体”以机械臂和人形机器人的形态具身化。

title.en: This is pure nightmare fuel. Identity theft of the past would be nothing compared to what vibe agents can do. Sending credentials is too obvious and for rookies
title.zh: This is pure nightmare fuel. Identity theft of the past would be nothing compared to what vibe agents can do. Sending credentials is too obvious and for rookies

note.en: Warns that autonomous 'vibe agents' could enable identity theft and contamination far worse than past methods.
note.zh: 警告自主“vibe智能体”可能带来比以往更严重的身份盗用和污染风险。

title.en: Teleop is so 2025. Ever since we unveiled EgoScale and the dexterity scaling law, it's been clear to us and the ecosystem that behavior cloning directly from hu
title.zh: Teleop is so 2025. Ever since we unveiled EgoScale and the dexterity scaling law, it's been clear to us and the ecosystem that behavior cloning directly from hu

note.en: Announces EgoScale and a dexterity scaling law, arguing behavior cloning from human video can replace teleoperation.
note.zh: 宣布EgoScale和灵巧度扩展定律，主张从人类视频进行行为克隆可取代遥操作。

title.en: We trained a humanoid with 22-DoF dexterous hands to assemble model cars, operate syringes, sort poker cards, fold/roll shirts, all learned primarily from 20,00
title.zh: We trained a humanoid with 22-DoF dexterous hands to assemble model cars, operate syringes, sort poker cards, fold/roll shirts, all learned primarily from 20,00

note.en: Announces a humanoid with 22-DoF dexterous hands trained mainly from over 20,000 hours of egocentric human video, performing tasks like assembly and folding.
note.zh: 宣布训练出具有22自由度灵巧手的人形机器人，主要通过2万多小时第一视角人类视频学习完成装配、叠衣等任务。

title.en: What can half of GPT-1 do? We trained a 42M transformer called SONIC to control the body of a humanoid robot. It takes a remarkable amount of subconscious proce
title.zh: What can half of GPT-1 do? We trained a 42M transformer called SONIC to control the body of a humanoid robot. It takes a remarkable amount of subconscious proce

note.en: Introduces SONIC, a 42M-parameter transformer controlling humanoid robot body movement.
note.zh: 发布SONIC，一个仅4200万参数、用于控制人形机器人身体动作的Transformer模型。

title.en: Announcing DreamDojo: our open-source, interactive world model that takes robot motor controls and generates the future in pixels. No engine, no meshes, no hand
title.zh: Announcing DreamDojo: our open-source, interactive world model that takes robot motor controls and generates the future in pixels. No engine, no meshes, no hand

note.en: Announces DreamDojo, an open-source interactive world model that predicts future video from robot motor commands.
note.zh: 发布DreamDojo，一个开源交互式世界模型，可根据机器人运动指令生成未来画面。

title.en: New milestone: we trained a robot foundation model on a world model backbone, and enabled zero-shot, open-world prompting capability for new verbs, nouns, and e
title.zh: New milestone: we trained a robot foundation model on a world model backbone, and enabled zero-shot, open-world prompting capability for new verbs, nouns, and e

note.en: Announces a robot foundation model built on a world-model backbone enabling zero-shot prompting for new objects and environments.
note.zh: 发布基于世界模型骨架构建的机器人基础模型，支持对新物体和新环境的零样本提示。

title.en: I still remember the excitement in 2023 when Stanford Smallville was launched. It was the largest multi-agent sim back then - yes, 25 bots felt like a lot. Toda
title.zh: I still remember the excitement in 2023 when Stanford Smallville was launched. It was the largest multi-agent sim back then - yes, 25 bots felt like a lot. Toda

note.en: Compares today's large-scale multi-agent simulations to the 2023 Stanford Smallville demo, calling the current scale a 'Bigville' moment.
note.zh: 将当下的大规模多智能体仿真与2023年斯坦福“Smallville”演示相比，称当前规模已达到“Bigville”阶段。

title.en: Everyone's freaking out about vibe coding. In the holiday spirit, allow me to share my anxiety on the wild west of robotics. 3 lessons I learned in 2025. 1. Har
title.zh: Everyone's freaking out about vibe coding. In the holiday spirit, allow me to share my anxiety on the wild west of robotics. 3 lessons I learned in 2025. 1. Har

note.en: Shares three lessons learned in 2025 about the gap between robotics hardware and software progress.
note.zh: 分享2025年关于机器人硬件与软件发展差距的三点心得。

title.en: 2024: AI is the copilot 2025+: humans are the copilot Copilot is the new engineering skill. It’s not easy to leave the driver seat - we must learn to think the
title.zh: 2024: AI is the copilot 2025+: humans are the copilot Copilot is the new engineering skill. It’s not easy to leave the driver seat - we must learn to think the

note.en: Argues the AI-human relationship is inverting — from AI as copilot to humans as copilot — as a new required engineering skill.
note.zh: 提出AI与人类关系正在反转——从AI作为副驾驶到人类成为副驾驶——并将其视为一项新的工程技能。

title.en: I'm on a singular mission to solve the Physical Turing Test for robotics. It's the next, or perhaps THE last grand challenge of AI. Super-intelligence in text s
title.zh: I'm on a singular mission to solve the Physical Turing Test for robotics. It's the next, or perhaps THE last grand challenge of AI. Super-intelligence in text s

note.en: States his mission is solving the 'Physical Turing Test' for robotics, calling it the next grand challenge after text-based superintelligence.
note.zh: 表示自己的使命是解决机器人领域的“物理图灵测试”，称其为文本超级智能之后的下一个重大挑战。

title.en: 2026: Mad Max all the way to solving autonomous driving for good. Humanity: zero takeover asymptotically. https://t.co/Bd1t9J0CoH
title.zh: 2026: Mad Max all the way to solving autonomous driving for good. Humanity: zero takeover asymptotically. https://t.co/Bd1t9J0CoH

note.en: Predicts 2026 will push autonomous driving toward a near-zero human takeover rate.
note.zh: 预测2026年自动驾驶的人工接管率将趋近于零。

title.en: I was very late to own a Tesla but among the earliest to try out FSD v14. It's perhaps the first time I experience an AI that passes the Physical Turing Test: a
title.zh: I was very late to own a Tesla but among the earliest to try out FSD v14. It's perhaps the first time I experience an AI that passes the Physical Turing Test: a

note.en: Describes Tesla FSD v14 as the first AI he's experienced that passes his 'Physical Turing Test' for everyday driving.
note.zh: 称特斯拉FSD v14是他体验过的第一个通过其“物理图灵测试”的日常驾驶AI。

title.en: LocateAnything3D: Vision-Language 3D Detection with Chain-of-Sight
title.zh: LocateAnything3D: Vision-Language 3D Detection with Chain-of-Sight

note.en: LocateAnything3D, an NVIDIA method giving vision-language models multi-object 3D detection through a chain-of-sight formulation.
note.zh: LocateAnything3D：英伟达提出的方法，用「视觉链」的方式让视觉语言模型具备多目标三维检测能力。

title.en: Listening to Jensen talk about his favorite maths - specs of Vera Rubin chips, and the full stack from lithography to robot fleets assembling physical fabs in A
title.zh: Listening to Jensen talk about his favorite maths - specs of Vera Rubin chips, and the full stack from lithography to robot fleets assembling physical fabs in A

note.en: Shares NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang's remarks on Vera Rubin chip specs and the full stack from lithography to robot-fleet-built factories.
note.zh: 转述英伟达CEO黄仁勋关于Vera Rubin芯片规格及从光刻到机器人集群建厂全栈方案的评论。

title.en: There was something deeply satisfying about ImageNet. It had a well curated training set. A clearly defined testing protocol. A competition that rallied the bes
title.zh: There was something deeply satisfying about ImageNet. It had a well curated training set. A clearly defined testing protocol. A competition that rallied the bes

note.en: Reflects on why ImageNet's curated dataset, clear benchmark and leaderboard made it such an effective driver of progress.
note.zh: 反思ImageNet凭借精心构建的数据集、清晰的测试标准和排行榜，为何能有效推动研究进展。

title.en: Would love to see the FSD Scaling Law, as it’s the only physical data flywheel at planetary scale. What’s the “emergent ability threshold” for model/data size?
title.zh: Would love to see the FSD Scaling Law, as it’s the only physical data flywheel at planetary scale. What’s the “emergent ability threshold” for model/data size?

note.en: Proposes an 'FSD Scaling Law' as the only physical data flywheel operating at planetary scale.
note.zh: 提出“FSD扩展定律”，认为这是唯一在全球尺度上运转的物理数据飞轮。

title.en: This may be a testament to the “Reasoning Core Hypothesis” - reasoning itself only needs a minimal level of linguistic competency, instead of giant knowledge ba
title.zh: This may be a testament to the “Reasoning Core Hypothesis” - reasoning itself only needs a minimal level of linguistic competency, instead of giant knowledge ba

note.en: Argues results support a 'Reasoning Core Hypothesis' — that reasoning needs only minimal linguistic competency rather than huge knowledge bases.
note.zh: 认为相关结果支持“推理核心假说”——推理只需要极少的语言能力，而非庞大的知识库。

title.en: World modeling for robotics is incredibly hard because (1) control of humanoid robots & 5-finger hands is wayyy harder than ⬆️⬅️⬇️➡️ in games (Genie 3); and (2)
title.zh: World modeling for robotics is incredibly hard because (1) control of humanoid robots & 5-finger hands is wayyy harder than ⬆️⬅️⬇️➡️ in games (Genie 3); and (2)

note.en: Explains why world modeling for robotics is harder than for games, citing humanoid control and diverse object interaction.
note.zh: 解释为何机器人领域的世界建模比游戏更难，原因在于人形控制和多样化的物体交互。

title.en: Evaluation is the hardest problem for physical AI systems: do you crash test cars every time you debug a new FSD build? Traditional game engine (sim 1.0) is an
title.zh: Evaluation is the hardest problem for physical AI systems: do you crash test cars every time you debug a new FSD build? Traditional game engine (sim 1.0) is an

note.en: Argues evaluation is the hardest problem for physical AI, since real-world testing can't be repeated like crash tests.
note.zh: 认为评估是物理AI面临的最难问题，因为现实世界的测试无法像撞车测试那样反复进行。

title.en: This is game engine 2.0. Some day, all the complexity of UE5 will be absorbed by a data-driven blob of attention weights. Those weights take as input game contr
title.zh: This is game engine 2.0. Some day, all the complexity of UE5 will be absorbed by a data-driven blob of attention weights. Those weights take as input game contr

note.en: Envisions a 'game engine 2.0' where a data-driven attention model replaces traditional engines like UE5.
note.zh: 设想“游戏引擎2.0”，即用数据驱动的注意力模型取代UE5等传统引擎。

title.en: No em dash should be baked into pretraining, post-training, alignment, system prompt, and every nook and cranny in an LLM’s lifecycle. It needs to be hardwired
title.zh: No em dash should be baked into pretraining, post-training, alignment, system prompt, and every nook and cranny in an LLM’s lifecycle. It needs to be hardwired

note.en: Jokes that em dashes should be purged from every stage of an LLM's lifecycle, drawing wide engagement in the AI community.
note.zh: 调侃应从大语言模型全生命周期的每个环节中剔除破折号，引发AI圈热烈反响。

title.en: Shengjia is one of the brightest, humblest, and most passionate scientists I know. We went to PhD together for 5 yrs, sitting across the hall at Stanford Gates
title.zh: Shengjia is one of the brightest, humblest, and most passionate scientists I know. We went to PhD together for 5 yrs, sitting across the hall at Stanford Gates

note.en: Pays tribute to a former Stanford PhD peer, Shengjia, calling them one of the brightest and most passionate scientists he knows.
note.zh: 向斯坦福读博时期的同窗Shengjia致敬，称其为自己认识的最聪明、最谦逊、最有热情的科学家之一。

title.en: I'm observing a mini Moravec's paradox within robotics: gymnastics that are difficult for humans are much easier for robots than "unsexy" tasks like cooking, cl
title.zh: I'm observing a mini Moravec's paradox within robotics: gymnastics that are difficult for humans are much easier for robots than "unsexy" tasks like cooking, cl

note.en: Observes a 'mini Moravec's paradox' in robotics: gymnastics is easier for robots than mundane tasks like cooking and cleaning.
note.zh: 观察到机器人领域存在“迷你莫拉维克悖论”：对机器人来说，体操比做饭、打扫等日常任务更容易。

title.en: My bar for AGI is far simpler: an AI cooking a nice dinner at anyone’s house for any cuisine. The Physical Turing Test is very likely harder than the Nobel Priz
title.zh: My bar for AGI is far simpler: an AI cooking a nice dinner at anyone’s house for any cuisine. The Physical Turing Test is very likely harder than the Nobel Priz

note.en: Sets his bar for AGI as an AI that can cook a full dinner in anyone's kitchen, calling it harder than winning a Nobel Prize.
note.zh: 将AGI的门槛定为能在任何人家中做出一顿像样晚餐的AI，称其难度超过获得诺贝尔奖。

title.en: I've been a bit quiet on X recently. The past year has been a transformational experience. Grok-4 and Kimi K2 are awesome, but the world of robotics is a wondro
title.zh: I've been a bit quiet on X recently. The past year has been a transformational experience. Grok-4 and Kimi K2 are awesome, but the world of robotics is a wondro

note.en: Reflects on a transformational year working in robotics after a quiet stretch on X, contrasting it with recent LLM releases like Grok-4 and Kimi K2.
note.zh: 在沉寂一段时间后回顾自己在机器人领域经历的变革性一年，并将其与Grok-4、Kimi K2等最新大模型发布相对照。

title.en: Jim Fan on Nvidia’s Embodied AI Lab and Jensen Huang’s Prediction that All Robots will be Autonomous
title.zh: Jim Fan on Nvidia’s Embodied AI Lab and Jensen Huang’s Prediction that All Robots will be Autonomous

note.en: Sequoia Training Data interview on NVIDIA's embodied AI lab, his path from OpenAI's first intern to GEAR, and the case for autonomous robots.
note.zh: 红杉 Training Data 访谈，谈英伟达的具身智能实验室、他从 OpenAI 首位实习生到 GEAR 的经历，以及机器人走向自主的理由。

title.en: The next grand challenge for AI | Jim Fan
title.zh: The next grand challenge for AI | Jim Fan

note.en: In a TED Tech talk, Jim Fan laid out the next grand challenge for AI: building a 'foundation agent' that operates seamlessly across both virtual and physical worlds.
note.zh: 在TED Tech演讲中，Jim Fan提出了AI领域的下一个重大挑战：打造能够无缝跨越虚拟与物理世界运行的基础智能体。

title.en: NVIDIA’s Jim Fan Delves Into Large Language Models and Their Industry Impact - Ep. 204
title.zh: NVIDIA’s Jim Fan Delves Into Large Language Models and Their Industry Impact - Ep. 204
